name: rbi_get_inflation
description:
Indian price indices: consumer price index (cpi), wholesale price index (wpi) or core CPI, from the Reserve Bank of India's DBIE endpoint (rbi.org.in/Scripts/api/dbie, no API key).
Returns: series_code, label, description, unit, frequency, observation_count and observations (date, value) as the endpoint orders them.
Inputs (* required): index_type* (cpi, wpi, core_cpi; schema default cpi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, passed through as fromDate and toDate); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
For policy rates use rbi_get_policy_rate.
Example: {"index_type": "cpi", "start_date": "2023-01-01"}
